decision: ADR-020 §3 (scheduler decision 2026-10-09): Action definitions NexLoop itself needs are published at deployment through trusted configuration (0050), compiled from this versioned declaration; never constructed ad hoc and never written to definition tables directly. Human-owner Actions (authority human_owner) are granted to the owner's human principal, never to service principals.

actions.purpose: Create the Message object of an Agent reply after the channel accepted it (NX-047); content, sender, conversation and delivery state come from the governed outbound record, never from the caller.
Publish the next immutable version of a Context strategy (budgets, quotas, trim order). Human owner only; SQL refuses services and Agents even with a grant (NX-023).

Read one model-call Manifest (sources, versions, request digest). Humans only (owner / audit role, owner decision 2026-10-09); SQL refuses services, Agents and Run credentials even with a grant; never in service-grants (NX-023).
